paidSeats.description:
Total paid seats after adjustment. Effective cap on the org is
plan.seat_limit + paid_seats (auth service reads paid_seats from
the local cache so this value matches what InviteMember will see
immediately after).

unitPriceCents.description:
Per-seat unit price in cents (e.g. 1500 = \$15.00). Frontend uses
this for "Charged \$X today, prorated" copy.

apiKeyId.description:
The gateway API key id. Empty for traffic that used no API key
(dashboard sessions, agent triggers, workflows, internal calls).

v1ApiKeySpend.description: ApiKeySpend is one gateway API key's spend this month.

failureMessage.description: Customer-safe reason and next step, for a failed attempt.

v1AutoTopUpAttempt.description: AutoTopUpAttempt is one auto top-up charge.

v1AutoTopUpAttemptOutcome.description: - AUTO_TOP_UP_ATTEMPT_OUTCOME_PENDING: Charge sent to the card, not confirmed yet.

thresholdCents.description: Whole USD cents. Charge when the balance drops below this.

amountCents.description: Whole USD cents charged per top-up.

monthlyCapCents.description: Whole USD cents; at most this much is charged per calendar month (UTC).

consentVersion.description:
The consent wording version the client rendered
(GetCreditPurchaseOptionsResponse.auto_top_up_consent_version).

v1AutoTopUpConsent.description: AutoTopUpConsent is the disclosed auto top-up terms a buyer agreed to.

configured.description: False when the organization never set up auto top-up.

usedThisMonthMicros.description: Charged or in flight this calendar month (UTC), and what is left.

version.description: Pass back as expected_version when saving.

chargeInFlight.description: A charge has been sent to the card and is not settled yet.

actionMessage.description: Customer-safe explanation of ACTION_REQUIRED or PAUSED.

nextAttemptAt.description: When the next charge may happen after a failure (ACTION_REQUIRED).

pausedReason.description:
Why it is PAUSED: "failed_payments", "dispute" or "refund". After a
dispute or refund only an owner or admin turning it back on resumes it.

v1AutoTopUpStatus.description:
- AUTO_TOP_UP_STATUS_OFF: Not set up, or turned off.
 - AUTO_TOP_UP_STATUS_ACTIVE: On and healthy.
 - AUTO_TOP_UP_STATUS_ACTION_REQUIRED: On, but the last charge failed; retried automatically after a wait.
 - AUTO_TOP_UP_STATUS_PAUSED: Stopped after repeated failed charges. Saving the settings resumes it.

keptInstances.description:
What happens at the period end: the instances that keep running on
Starter and the ones that pause. Without keep_instance_ids the most
recently active are kept.

A scheduled downgrade: the instances that keep running and the ones
that pause at the switch.

v1ClientActionKind.description:
ClientActionKind is a step the customer must finish in Stripe.

 - CLIENT_ACTION_KIND_CONFIRM_PAYMENT: Pay or authenticate (SCA) the upgrade invoice on Stripe's hosted page.
The change applies once it is paid; Stripe drops it if it is not paid
within about a day.
 - CLIENT_ACTION_KIND_ADD_PAYMENT_METHOD: Add a payment method in the Stripe portal, then retry ChangePlan.
Nothing was changed.

clientSecret.description:
Stripe SetupIntent client secret for stripe.confirmSetup. Short-lived;
never log or persist it.

v1CreditEntryType.description:
CreditEntryType is the kind of one credit ledger entry.

 - CREDIT_ENTRY_TYPE_GRANT: Credit issued by Everstack (signup grant, promotion, ops grant).
 - CREDIT_ENTRY_TYPE_PURCHASE: Credit bought by the customer.
 - CREDIT_ENTRY_TYPE_DEBIT: Usage that consumed credit.
 - CREDIT_ENTRY_TYPE_REFUND: Reversal of a debit.
 - CREDIT_ENTRY_TYPE_EXPIRY: Unused granted credit removed when it expired.
 - CREDIT_ENTRY_TYPE_ADJUSTMENT: Correction in either direction.

amountMicros.description: Signed: positive adds credit, negative consumes it.

resourceType.description: Empty when the entry is not tied to a resource.

description.description: Human readable summary, for example "Inference: gpt-4o-mini".

model.description: Model for inference entries, when recorded.

v1CreditLedgerEntry.description: CreditLedgerEntry is one customer-visible ledger row.

requestedMicros.description: Pre-tax credit requested, in micro-dollars (1 USD = 1,000,000).

reversedMicros.description: Credit clawed back by refunds and lost disputes.

amountTotalMinor.description: Amount charged including tax, in minor units of `currency` (0 until paid).

v1CreditPurchase.description: CreditPurchase is one prepaid credit purchase attempt.

v1CreditPurchaseState.description:
CreditPurchaseState mirrors billing.credit_purchases.state.

 - CREDIT_PURCHASE_STATE_PENDING: Created; the customer is on (or left) the Stripe Checkout page.
 - CREDIT_PURCHASE_STATE_PAID: Paid and minted. The only state that means the credit is available.
 - CREDIT_PURCHASE_STATE_FAILED: A delayed payment method failed.
 - CREDIT_PURCHASE_STATE_EXPIRED: The Checkout session expired unpaid.
 - CREDIT_PURCHASE_STATE_ACTION_REQUIRED: Checkout completed; the payment is still processing.
 - CREDIT_PURCHASE_STATE_REFUNDED: Fully refunded; the credit was clawed back.
 - CREDIT_PURCHASE_STATE_DISPUTED: A chargeback is open or was lost.
 - CREDIT_PURCHASE_STATE_NEEDS_REVIEW: Paid but held for manual review (for example a non-USD payment).

v1CreditSpend.description: CreditSpend is the net credit one resource consumed (debits minus refunds).

v1CreditWalletState.description:
CreditWalletState summarises whether the wallet can pay for new usage.

 - CREDIT_WALLET_STATE_ACTIVE: Available credit is positive.
 - CREDIT_WALLET_STATE_EXHAUSTED: Available credit is zero or negative.

available.description:
False while auto top-up is switched off for this deployment; the UI
hides it.

minAmountUsd.description: Bounds for the edit dialog, whole USD.

balanceMicros.description: Signed sum of every ledger entry. Can be negative.

heldMicros.description: Credit reserved by in-flight requests and not yet settled.

availableMicros.description: balance_micros - held_micros: what new usage can spend now.

asOf.description: When the ledger was read (database clock).

grantedMicros.description: Lifetime totals. balance = granted + purchased - spent - expired + adjusted.

spentMicros.description: Net consumption: debits minus refunds, as a positive number.

expiredMicros.description: Granted credit that expired unused, as a positive number.

spendByResource.description:
Lifetime spend per resource, largest first. Resources with no net
spend are omitted.

signupGrantMicros.description: The one-time signup grant included in granted_micros (0 when none).

planCreditGrantedMicros.description:
Plan credit from the earlier subscription model (fee converted into
period credit, resource_type "subscription"). Included in granted_micros.

planCreditExpiredMicros.description:
The part of plan_credit_granted_micros that expired, as a positive number.
Included in expired_micros.

grantedCurrentMicros.description:
Headline totals: granted_micros and expired_micros with expired plan
credit netted out of both, so credit that is gone and was never part of
the prepaid wallet does not inflate either figure. The identity
balance = granted_current + purchased - spent - expired_current + adjusted
still holds.

signupGrantExpiresAt.description:
When the signup grant's unspent remainder expires (30 days after it was
granted). Unset when the org holds no signup grant or its grant predates
the 30-day rule and never expires.

enabled.description: False while self-serve purchase is switched off; the UI hides Buy.

presetsUsd.description: Preset top-up amounts, whole USD, pre-tax.

offerAutoTopUp.description:
True when the Buy dialog should show the pre-checked auto top-up box:
auto top-up is available and the organization has no policy yet.

autoTopUpDefaultThresholdUsd.description:
Defaults for that box: the threshold, and the monthly cap as a multiple
of the amount being bought (the refill amount is the amount bought).

autoTopUpConsentVersion.description: Version of the consent wording; send it back in AutoTopUpConsent.

expiresAt.description:
Unset until the free requests are granted (on first use); they expire a
fixed number of days after the grant.

resumesAt.description: Set when paused by today's limit: the next 00:00 UTC.

model.description:
The one model free requests are served on, and the output cap per
request.

activations.title: All activations when instance_id not provided

today.description: The current UTC day and UTC month, for the whole organization.

apiKeys.description:
Every API key with recorded attempts this month, highest month spend
first. Sums to the organization totals.

asOf.description:
Attempts recorded up to this time are included. Unset until the rollup
job has completed its first pass.

hasBillingPortal.description:
True when the organization has a Stripe customer, so
CreateBillingPortalSession can open the portal (payment methods and
invoices) even without a subscription, e.g. after a credit top-up.

summary.description:
Everything one plan summary needs, computed server side. Set whenever
subscription is set. Members without org:manage_billing get the
read-only subset (see SubscriptionSummary).

estimatedCostMicros.description:
Cost & cache breakdown for the current period (not quota-shaped).
Costs are in micro-dollars (USD * 1_000_000) to preserve sub-cent precision.

networkRxBytes.description: Sandbox network data transfer this period (bytes).

sandboxComputeSeconds.description:
Sandbox compute charged in this billing period. Compute accrues per
second while the VM is allocated, including idle time; sleeping and
stopped sandboxes do not accrue compute.

browserRuntimeSeconds.description:
Hosted-browser time charged in this billing period. Idle pool capacity is
excluded; the one-minute minimum and per-second increments are finalized
by the browser serving plane before this cumulative meter is reported.

sandboxStarterCreditMicros.description:
One-time organization starter credit for managed sandbox compute. These
values are lifetime scoped and do not reset with the billing period.

sandboxComputeAllowed.description:
False once the starter credit is exhausted unless active billing (or an
Enterprise contract) authorizes continued compute.

unmeteredFields.description:
Names of the top-level usage fields above that nothing reports for this
organization yet, spelled as their proto field names (for example
"cache_savings_micros", "network_rx_bytes"). Clients render these as not
metered instead of 0. Empty from servers older than this field, which
means render every field as before.

customerKey.description:
True when the attempt ran on the customer's own provider key. Such
attempts are never charged.

inputTokens.description: Unset when not recorded (history from before attempts were recorded).

estimated.description:
The provider reported no usage (the stream was cut off, or sent no usage
chunk), so the tokens are Everstack's estimate.

charged.description: Whether the attempt consumed credit, and how much (positive).

v1InferenceAttemptRole.description:
InferenceAttemptRole is why an attempt was made and how it ended.

 - INFERENCE_ATTEMPT_ROLE_UNSPECIFIED: Not recorded (history from before attempts were recorded).
 - INFERENCE_ATTEMPT_ROLE_SERVED: Its response was returned to the caller.
 - INFERENCE_ATTEMPT_ROLE_RACE_LOSER: A leg of a parallel race that another leg won.
 - INFERENCE_ATTEMPT_ROLE_FAILED_FALLBACK: Failed, after which fallback tried the next provider.
 - INFERENCE_ATTEMPT_ROLE_RETRY: A repeat of the same target that the routing configuration asked for.
 - INFERENCE_ATTEMPT_ROLE_PLATFORM_RETRY: A repeat Everstack made for its own reasons. Never charged.
 - INFERENCE_ATTEMPT_ROLE_INTERRUPTED: Broke off part way (for example a stream that failed) with nothing
configured to take over. Charged for the tokens it generated.

groupKey.description:
Opaque key, stable across pages, for UI state such as which groups are
expanded. Not an identifier to show.

servedCount.description: Attempts whose answer was returned, internal calls excluded.

chargedMicros.description: Sum of the charged attempts' amounts (positive).

v1InferenceRequestAttempts.description: InferenceRequestAttempts is every attempt of one request, oldest first.

nextPageToken.description: Empty when there are no more entries.
Empty when there are no more requests.

v1ModelTrialState.description:
ModelTrialState is the state of an organization's free model requests.

 - MODEL_TRIAL_STATE_ACTIVE: Free requests can be used now.
 - MODEL_TRIAL_STATE_EXHAUSTED: Every free request is used.
 - MODEL_TRIAL_STATE_EXPIRED: The free requests expired (see expires_at).
 - MODEL_TRIAL_STATE_PAUSED: Free requests are paused for everyone: until resumes_at when set,
otherwise until further notice.
 - MODEL_TRIAL_STATE_NOT_ELIGIBLE: The organization has no free requests.

id.description: Everstack id of the saved method; pass it to SetDefault/Remove.

type.description: Stripe payment method type, for example "card" or "link".

brand.description: Card network, for example "visa" or "mastercard". Empty for non-cards.

expiringSoon.description: True in the card's last two months of validity (this month or next).

expired.description: True once the expiry month has passed.

wallet.description:
Wallet the card was added through, for example "apple_pay". Empty
for a card entered directly.

linkEmail.description:
Email of the Link account, for type "link". Only returned to owners and
admins; empty for other members and for every other type.

billingAddressLine1.description:
Billing address lines of a card. Only returned to owners and admins, to
prefill the edit form.

v1PaymentMethod.description:
PaymentMethod is display metadata for a saved Stripe payment method. It
never carries a card number or security code: those never reach Everstack.

v1PaymentRecoveryStatus.description:
PaymentRecoveryStatus is the outcome of paying an overdue subscription
invoice with a newly chosen default card.

 - PAYMENT_RECOVERY_STATUS_PAID: Paid; the subscription returns to active through the usual webhooks.
 - PAYMENT_RECOVERY_STATUS_ACTION_REQUIRED: The bank requires authentication: send the customer to client_action
(CONFIRM_PAYMENT, Stripe's hosted invoice).
 - PAYMENT_RECOVERY_STATUS_FAILED: The card was declined or Stripe failed. The card stays the default and
Stripe keeps retrying; client_action points at the hosted invoice to
pay another way.

v1PlanChangeDirection.description:
PlanChangeDirection classifies a change: tier rank first, then the price
of the target interval for a same-plan interval switch.

 - PLAN_CHANGE_DIRECTION_NONE: Target equals the current plan and interval. ChangePlan with no change
withdraws any scheduled change instead.

wouldPause.description:
True when it would pause at the switch under the given (or default)
keep choice.

paidExtra.description:
True when it already runs as a paid extra instance (credit-funded fee)
and holds no plan slot.

v1PlanChangeInstance.description: PlanChangeInstance is one managed instance that holds a plan slot.

v1PlanChangeOutcome.description:
PlanChangeOutcome is what ChangePlan did.

 - PLAN_CHANGE_OUTCOME_APPLIED: Upgrade applied and paid.
 - PLAN_CHANGE_OUTCOME_SCHEDULED: Downgrade or cheaper interval scheduled for the period end.
 - PLAN_CHANGE_OUTCOME_UNCHANGED: Already on the target (a scheduled change, if any, was withdrawn).
 - PLAN_CHANGE_OUTCOME_ACTION_REQUIRED: The customer must finish client_action.

v1PlanChangeTiming.description:
PlanChangeTiming says when a plan change takes effect.

 - PLAN_CHANGE_TIMING_IMMEDIATE: Applied now, with a prorated charge for the rest of the period.
 - PLAN_CHANGE_TIMING_PERIOD_END: Scheduled for the end of the current period (downgrades, cheaper
intervals, cancellation).

v1PlanChoice.description:
PlanChoice names a self-serve plan. The server maps it (with a
BillingPeriod) to the Stripe price; clients never send price ids.

 - PLAN_CHOICE_STARTER: Starter (tier "free"). Reached by cancelling; ChangePlan rejects it.
 - PLAN_CHOICE_BUILD: Build (tier "basic").
 - PLAN_CHOICE_SCALE: Scale (tier "pro").

v1PlanConfig.title: PlanConfig contains the full plan definition

usageLimits.description: Named usage limits from the catalog (-1 = unlimited).

v1PlanLimitsSummary.description: PlanLimitsSummary is the part of a plan's limits a change affects.

effectiveAt.description: Now for an immediate change; the end of the current period otherwise.

instances.description: Every instance holding a slot under the current plan.

overLimitInstances.description:
The instances that exceed the new limit and would pause at the switch
(would_pause = true), under keep_instance_ids or the default.

keepChoiceRequired.description:
True when the new limit leaves instances to pause, so the UI should
offer a keep choice (preselect the instances with would_pause = false).
Not required: without one, the most recently active are kept.

maxKeep.description: How many instances keep_instance_ids may name (the new instance limit).

prorationAmountDue.description:
Immediate changes: the prorated amount charged now, smallest currency
unit (Stripe invoice preview). Unset for scheduled changes or when
Stripe could not price it.

targetPriceAmount.description: The recurring price of the target plan and period, smallest unit.

extraInstanceMonthlyCents.description:
Credit-funded extra instances: the monthly wallet fee per instance
beyond the plan limit, and what keeping every over-limit instance as an
extra would cost per month. Both 0 when the option is unavailable.

hasPaymentMethod.description:
Upgrades charge the default saved card. False means ChangePlan will
return an ADD_PAYMENT_METHOD action instead of charging.

checkoutUrl.description: Stripe Checkout URL to redirect the browser to.

targetPlanName.description: Catalog display name of the target plan ("Build").

scheduledInApp.description:
False when the change was scheduled outside the app (for example in
the Stripe portal); keep_instance_ids is then empty.

v1ScheduledPlanChange.description:
ScheduledPlanChange is a plan or interval change that takes effect at
the end of the current period.

paymentRecovery.description:
Set when a subscription was past due or unpaid with an open invoice
and the new default card was tried on it. Every live subscription is
moved to the new default card either way.

v1SpendBasis.description:
SpendBasis is what a spend limit counts (docs/design/spend-limits-v2.md
4.1). UNSPECIFIED on a write keeps an existing limit's basis and creates
a PLATFORM_CREDIT limit, so callers that predate it are unchanged.

 - SPEND_BASIS_PLATFORM_CREDIT: Everstack credit only: limits written before spend limits v2.
 - SPEND_BASIS_ALL_INFERENCE: Everstack credit charged plus traffic on the organization's own provider
keys at catalog list price: one combined budget.

apiKeyId.description:
The gateway API key this limit applies to. Unset on organization and
instance limits.

notifyPercents.description:
Percentages of the limit at which owners and admins are emailed. Fixed
at 80 and 100 for now.

apiKeyName.description:
Display name of the API key, as given when the limit was set. Unset on
organization and instance limits.

v1SpendLimit.title: SpendLimit represents a spending limit configuration

v1SpendLimitAction.title: SpendLimitAction represents the action to take when limit is exceeded

v1SpendLimitPeriod.title: SpendLimitPeriod represents the period for spend limits

v1SpendLimitType.title: SpendLimitType represents the type of spend limit

start.description: Inclusive window start (00:00 UTC of the day, or of the 1st of the month).

resetsAt.description: Exclusive window end: when the window resets (00:00 UTC).

platformMicros.description: Everstack credit charged, as billed (with markup).

byokEstimatedMicros.description:
Traffic on the organization's own provider keys at catalog list price,
no markup. An estimate: the provider's invoice is authoritative.

attempts.description: Provider attempts in the window, priced or not.

unpricedAttempts.description:
Attempts on the organization's own keys for models without a list
price. They count $0 and are not in spent_micros.

estimated.description: True when spent_micros includes an estimate (byok_estimated_micros > 0).

v1SpendTotals.description: SpendTotals is estimated inference spend over one window.

resume.description:
ResumeSubscription: withdraws a scheduled cancellation or a scheduled
plan change.

switchInterval.description: ChangePlan to the other billing period of the current plan.

v1SubscriptionAllowedActions.description:
SubscriptionAllowedActions is what the caller may do now. Server
computed; the UI should not re-derive it. All false for members without
org:manage_billing.

type.description: Stripe payment method type, for example "card" or "link".

source.description:
"subscription" when set on the subscription itself, "customer_default"
when it falls back to the organization's default method.

v1SubscriptionPaymentMethod.description:
SubscriptionPaymentMethod is the display summary of the card or method
that pays the subscription. Never a full number.

v1SubscriptionStatus.title: SubscriptionStatus represents the current state of a subscription

planName.description: Catalog display name ("Starter", "Build", "Scale"); never the tier.

currentPeriodStart.description:
The real period: Stripe's license item when it could be read, else the
stored row. Never projected.

renewsAt.description:
Next renewal; unset when a cancellation is scheduled or the
subscription has ended.

cancelsAt.description: When a scheduled cancellation takes effect.

pastDueGraceEndsAt.description:
End of the past-due grace window. Reserved for the dunning slice; not
set yet.

nextInvoice.description:
Manager only. Unset when nothing is due (cancellation scheduled,
ended) or Stripe could not be read.

needsReview.description:
True when the stored subscription disagrees with Stripe or with
itself and someone should look (see review_reasons).

keepInstanceIds.description:
Manager only. Instances chosen to keep when the scheduled cancellation
or downgrade takes effect; the rest pause then. Empty means "keep the
most recently active".

managerView.description:
False when the caller lacks org:manage_billing and manager-only fields
were withheld.

v1SubscriptionSummary.description:
SubscriptionSummary is the plan summary view. Fields marked "manager
only" are left unset for members without org:manage_billing.

free.description:
Free has no license price; its synced plan contains the usage-only
sandbox meter product managed by the billing service.

v1SyncedPlans.title: SyncedPlans contains the synced plan price IDs from Stripe

amountDue.description: Smallest currency unit (cents for USD), tax and credits included.

date.description: When Stripe will attempt to collect it.

v1UpcomingInvoice.description:
UpcomingInvoice is the next invoice Stripe will raise for the
subscription (Stripe invoice preview, cached for a few minutes).

v1UsageHistoryPoint.title: UsageHistoryPoint - One daily data point for a metric

v1UsageMetering.description:
UsageMetering says whether billing has a producer for a usage metric, so a
client can tell a measured zero from a metric nobody reports yet.

 - USAGE_METERING_UNSPECIFIED: Sent by servers older than this field. Clients render the value as before.
 - USAGE_METERING_METERED: A producer reports this metric for the organization; used is a measurement.
 - USAGE_METERING_NOT_METERED: Nothing reports this metric for the organization yet. used is 0 because
there is no data, not because nothing was used.
